description: Download the signed attestation (Ed25519) for a completed run. Returns the canonical JSON report, its SHA-256 hash, and the signature. Anyone can verify it at shipsealed.com/verify without an account.

api_key.description: Airlock Monitor API key (starts with amk_).

base_url.description: Base URL of the Monitor instance (default: https://app.shipsealed.com).

run_id.description: The run id of a completed run.

name: get_monitor_attestation
